description: PRO. Recent US bank failures (and acquirers), newest first, optional state filter. Results include `status` (`ok` or `lookup_failed`), `retrieved_at` (ISO 8601 UTC, when this result was produced) and `source_updated_at` (when the FDIC data was fetched, including cache hits). A failed FDIC lookup returns `status: lookup_failed` and is distinct from zero matches (`status: ok`).
name: bank_failures
